english.meaning: to pay attention to someone; to react to them
english.note: Often negative: 唔睬佢 means to ignore him.

exampleSentences.english: Exactly. We’d be fools to respond to him right away.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係囖。噉樣我哋就即刻睬佢都傻啊真係。
